title: KanbanBoard
description: A board of status columns (To do / Doing / Done): equal-width columns with a title, a count and an accent color, stacked cards, and horizontal scrolling. Drag and drop is not built in: move cards with your own actions.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: KanbanBoard is a labelled, keyboard-scrollable region of KanbanColumn; each column is a group named by its title and count, and its cards (here minerva Cards) form a list. There is no drag and drop: move cards with your own actions (a button or a menu) and update your data.

colors.title: Colors and counts
colors.description: color puts an accent dot before the title: a theme color (primary, success, warning, danger, info, neutral) or any CSS color. count shows a badge, announced with the title. columnWidth and gap size the columns; on narrow screens they keep their width and snap while the board scrolls.

empty-actions.title: Empty state, actions and footer
empty-actions.description: actions sits at the end of the header (e.g. an add button), description under it and footer below the cards. A column without cards shows empty ("No items" by default, translated). fill stretches the columns equally when they fit.

fixed-height.title: Fixed height
fixed-height.description: height or maxHeight bound the board: each column body scrolls vertically while the board scrolls horizontally.

KanbanBoardProps.columnWidth: Width of every column (a number is pixels); with fill it is the minimum width
KanbanBoardProps.fill: Stretches the columns equally to fill the board when they fit (they keep columnWidth as their minimum width and scroll otherwise)
KanbanBoardProps.gap: Space between the columns (a number is pixels)
KanbanBoardProps.height: Height of the board: the column bodies scroll vertically within it (a number is pixels)
KanbanBoardProps.maxHeight: Maximum height of the board: the column bodies scroll vertically within it (a number is pixels)
KanbanBoardProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the board region
KanbanBoardProps.aria-labelledby: Id of an element naming the board (instead of aria-label)

KanbanColumnProps.title: Title of the column (also its accessible name)
KanbanColumnProps.count: Number of items shown as a badge next to the title (and announced with it); omit to hide the badge
KanbanColumnProps.color: Accent of the column (a dot before the title): a theme color or any CSS color
KanbanColumnProps.actions: Header controls on the end side (e.g. an add button)
KanbanColumnProps.empty: Content shown when the column has no cards
KanbanColumnProps.footer: Footer below the cards (e.g. an "Add card" button)
KanbanColumnProps.children: The cards: each child is wrapped in a role="listitem"
KanbanColumnProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the column (defaults to the title with the count, e.g. "To do, 3 items")

cssVars.--kanban-column-width: Width of the columns (defaults to 18rem; the columnWidth prop sets it; with fill it is the minimum width)
cssVars.--kanban-gap: Space between the columns (defaults to 0.75rem; the gap prop sets it)
cssVars.--kanban-column-border-color: Border color of a column (defaults to --border-color)
cssVars.--kanban-column-radius: Corner radius of a column (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--kanban-column-color: Accent of a column: the dot before the title (the color prop sets it for a custom CSS color)
cssVars.--kanban-card-gap: Space between the cards of a column (defaults to --space-2)
cssVars.--kanban-count-background: Background of the count badge (defaults to --surface-color)
cssVars.--kanban-count-color: Text color of the count badge (defaults to --text-secondary-color)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: minerva-kanban-column elements in a minerva-kanban-board; slotted cards get role="listitem". No drag and drop: here each card moves to the next column with its own button, and the script updates the count attributes.

colors.title: Colors and counts
colors.description: color takes a theme color (also the :state(color-success) ... custom states) or any CSS color; count shows a badge announced with the heading. column-width and gap size the columns.

empty-actions.title: Empty state and actions
empty-actions.description: The actions slot sits at the end of the header; empty-text (or the empty slot) shows while the column has no cards; fill stretches the columns when they fit.

fixed-height.title: Fixed height
fixed-height.description: height or max-height bound the board: each column body scrolls vertically while the board scrolls horizontally.

methods.focus: Focuses the scrolling region (the arrow keys then scroll it).

props.heading: Title of the column (also its accessible name; or the heading slot)
props.emptyText: Text shown when there are no cards (defaults to the translated "No items"; or the empty slot)

slots.default: The cards (each gets role="listitem" unless it has a role)
slots.heading: Rich title (alternative to the heading attribute)
slots.actions: Header controls on the end side (e.g. an add button)
slots.description: Supporting text (alternative to the description attribute)
slots.empty: Content shown when there are no cards
slots.footer: Footer below the cards (e.g. an "Add card" button)

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: A horizontal ScrollView of columns that snaps column by column; cards move with their own buttons.
